description: Four white takeaway cups with plastic lids sit on the table in front of a red curtain backdrop. The left hand reaches forward to the leftmost cup while the right hand comes in from the right, and together they lift and pry up the lid; the right hand holds the removed lid off to the side as the left hand steadies the now open cup, then the hands repeat by grabbing another lidded cup and pulling its lid free, leaving multiple lids set down on the tabletop.
